collection.title: VW Golf Estate 2009 to 2011 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A VW Golf Estate 2009 to 2011 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 19" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this Golf Estate, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
